cluster.kubectl_note: the Kubernetes client built into oc, invoked as kubectl

entries.cmd: oc create serviceaccount ci-deploy && oc create rolebinding ci-deploy-edit --clusterrole=edit --serviceaccount="$(oc project -q):ci-deploy"
oc get configmap kube-root-ca.crt -o jsonpath='{.data.ca\.crt}' > api-ca.crt && grep -c 'BEGIN CERTIFICATE' api-ca.crt
oc config set-credentials ci-deploy --token="$(oc create token ci-deploy --duration=1h)" --kubeconfig=ci-deploy.kubeconfig

oc config set-context ci-deploy --cluster=training --user=ci-deploy --namespace="$(oc project -q)" --kubeconfig=ci-deploy.kubeconfig && oc config use-context ci-deploy --kubeconfig=ci-deploy.kubeconfig

entries.cmd: openssl req -new -newkey rsa:3072 -nodes -keyout ann.key -subj '/O=academy-auditors/CN=academy-ann' -out ann.csr 2>/dev/null && openssl req -in ann.csr -noout -subject

cat <<EOF | oc create -f -
apiVersion: certificates.k8s.io/v1
kind: CertificateSigningRequest
metadata:
  name: academy-ann
spec:
  request: $(base64 -w0 ann.csr)
  signerName: kubernetes.io/kube-apiserver-client
  expirationSeconds: 600
  usages:
  - client auth
EOF
